title: PageIndex R2L Evidence Crosswalk and PDF Ingestion
constraints: Start with dry-run previews and explicit validation gates
Preserve user data surfaces: do not mutate vaults, trackers, or remote systems until dry-run plans pass
Emit machine-readable artifacts agents can resume

metadata.outcome: A safe ingestion project that segments local PDFs, uploads/updates PageIndex documents with R2L, records document IDs and page anchors, and emits a vault-facing crosswalk for SAQ, LO, and MCQ grounding.

nodes.title: Inventory local PDFs and remote PageIndex folders
nodes.content: List local PDFs, existing remote docs, R2L status, folder IDs, and deletion/reupload constraints.
acceptanceCriteria: Dry-run inventory shows exact create/update/remove set

nodes.title: Segment large PDFs into topic-level documents
nodes.content: Use the PageIndex CLI segmentation plan to split high-density notes into stable topic PDFs with deterministic names and page ranges.

nodes.title: Upload or update with R2L enabled
nodes.content: Perform one-document apply smoke test, then batch upload with R2L and folder placement; avoid destructive deletion unless API behavior is proven.
acceptanceCriteria: At least one minimal end-to-end upload/R2L run succeeds before batch apply

nodes.title: Capture PageIndex IDs, R2L state, and anchors
nodes.content: Persist document IDs, fileName, folder, page ranges, and OCR/R2L readiness into a local manifest.

nodes.title: Build SAQ/LO/MCQ evidence crosswalk
nodes.content: Map PageIndex documents and page anchors onto vault SAQs, learning objectives, MCQs, and future answer generation bundles.

nodes.title: Audit drift and unresolved sources
nodes.content: Detect missing file names, API remove failures, unmapped documents, duplicate IDs, and stale R2L statuses.

edges.description: remote mutation must be preceded by a dry-run exact target set
stable document IDs unlock reproducible citation anchors
